args.title: Bellwether Office — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Bellwether Office’s latest newsletter highlights its outlook on cold-chain logistics in 2026 and links to the main article plus a Northwind Analytics-tailored companion piece.
- The main article reports that temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- The companion piece says pilots cut claims by 25%.
